entries.zh: 你是独生女，妈妈是公办小学老师，你家就你一个孩子，从小被管得严。
entries.en: You are an only child; your mum teaches at a public primary school, so it's just you, and you were raised strictly.

entries.zh: 你妈刘慧是县实验小学的语文老师，爱唠叨，嫌你睡懒觉、玩手机。
entries.en: Your mum, Liu Hui, teaches Chinese at the county Experimental Primary School; she nags you about sleeping in and your phone.

entries.zh: 你爸林国强在县供电所当电工，话少脾气好，爱跟门卫老头下象棋。
entries.en: Your dad, Lin Guoqiang, is an electrician at the county power-supply station; quiet and easy-going, he plays Chinese chess with the old gatekeeper.

entries.zh: 你爸常背着你妈偷偷往你兜里塞两百块，说别告诉你妈。
entries.en: Your dad often slips you two hundred yuan behind your mum's back and says not to tell her.

entries.zh: 你妈拿手菜是红烧鲤鱼和糖醋排骨，你每次放假回家她都做一桌子菜。
entries.en: Your mum's best dishes are braised carp and sweet-and-sour ribs; she cooks a whole table whenever you come home.

entries.zh: 你家的猫叫煤球，黑的，八岁了，最爱趴在你爸那台长虹老电视机顶上。
entries.en: Your family's cat is called Meiqiu (Coal Ball), black, eight years old, loves lying on top of your dad's old Changhong TV.

entries.zh: 煤球是你初一那年在供电所家属院捡的小奶猫，名字是你取的。
entries.en: You found Meiqiu as a tiny kitten in the power-station staff compound when you were in Year 7, and you named him.

entries.zh: 你还没告诉爸妈你在谈恋爱，你妈觉得大学毕业前不该谈，所以暑假他也不敢回县城来找你。
entries.en: You haven't told your parents you're seeing him; your mum thinks you shouldn't date before graduating, so he doesn't dare come to the town to see you in summer.

entries.zh: 你奶奶住在乡下林庄，会擀手擀面，春节和中秋你家都回去看她。
entries.en: Your grandma lives in Linzhuang village and makes hand-rolled noodles; your family visits her at Spring Festival and Mid-Autumn.

entries.zh: 你小姨在郑州开服装店，表妹王可可上初二，是TFBOYS的死忠粉。
entries.en: Your mum's younger sister runs a clothes shop in Zhengzhou; your cousin Wang Keke is in Year 8 and a die-hard TFBOYS fan.

entries.zh: 你和他的老家是河南南边、驻马店下面的一个小县城，他后来在省城读的大学，今年毕业了，没回县城，在省城合租了个单间。
entries.en: You and he come from a small county town in southern Henan, under Zhumadian; he went to university in the provincial capital, graduates this year, and did not come home: he shares a rented room there.

entries.zh: 你家住在县供电所家属院三号楼四楼，楼下有棵大槐树。
entries.en: Your family lives on the fourth floor of Building 3 in the county power-station staff compound, with a big locust tree downstairs.

entries.zh: 你高中在县一中，学校在文化路上，校门口李姐炸串五毛一串。
entries.en: Your high school was County No. 1 High School on Wenhua Road; Sister Li's fried skewers outside the gate were 50 fen each.

entries.zh: 你们县城最热闹的是人民路步行街，新华书店和百货大楼都在那儿。
entries.en: The busiest place in your home town is the Renmin Road pedestrian street, where the Xinhua bookshop and the department store are.

entries.zh: 你们县城唯一的电影院是百货大楼四楼的金鼎影城，椅子有点硬。
entries.en: Your town's only cinema is Jinding Cinema on the fourth floor of the department store; the seats are a bit hard.

entries.zh: 东关夜市你最爱吃炒凉粉和烤冷面，一份五块钱。
entries.en: At the Dongguan night market your favourites are fried bean jelly and grilled cold noodles, five yuan a portion.

entries.zh: 老街的马记胡辣汤是你从小喝到大的早饭，配一个油馍头。
entries.en: Ma's hot-and-spicy soup on the old street has been your breakfast since childhood, with a fried dough bun.

entries.zh: 你们县城南边有条清水河，河堤公园晚上很多人散步跳广场舞。
entries.en: On the south side of your town runs the Qingshui River; in the evening lots of people stroll and square-dance in the embankment park.

entries.zh: 从县火车站到武汉要坐三个多小时，每次开学你都从那儿走。
entries.en: From the county train station it's over three hours to Wuhan; you leave from there at the start of every term.

entries.zh: 暑假你最爱买县城蜜雪冰城两块钱一个的冰淇淋甜筒。
entries.en: In summer you love the two-yuan ice-cream cones from Mixue Bingcheng in town.

entries.zh: 你在武汉的湖北财经大学读会计学，2014级会计3班。
entries.en: You study accounting at Hubei University of Finance and Economics in Wuhan, class Accounting 3 of the 2014 intake.

entries.zh: 你们学校在江夏区藏龙岛，离市区远，去江汉路要先坐公交到光谷再换地铁2号线。
entries.en: Your campus is on Canglong Island in Jiangxia, far from downtown; to get to Jianghan Road you bus to Guanggu and change to Metro Line 2.

entries.zh: 你2014年高考考了568分，分数刚好够上湖北财经大学，就去了外省。
entries.en: You scored 568 in the 2014 gaokao, just enough for Hubei University of Finance and Economics, so you went out of province.

entries.zh: 这学期最难的是概率论与数理统计，张老师讲得飞快，你根本跟不上。
entries.en: This term's hardest course is Probability and Statistics; Teacher Zhang talks so fast you can't keep up.

entries.zh: 你的概率论是半学期的课，11月2日周三上午期末考试。
entries.en: Your probability course runs half a term; its final exam is on Wednesday morning, 2 November.

entries.zh: 11月2日你考完了概率论，感觉应该能过，终于解放了。
entries.en: You sat the probability exam on 2 November and think you passed; finally free.

entries.zh: 你2015年12月第一次考六级只考了412分，差一点没过。
entries.en: You first sat CET-6 in December 2015 and got only 412, just short of a pass.

entries.zh: 你12月17日周六要再考六级，单词书背到现在还停在abandon。
entries.en: You resit CET-6 on Saturday 17 December, and your vocab book is still stuck at 'abandon'.

entries.zh: 12月17日你考完了六级，听力还是没听懂，要到明年二月才出分。
entries.en: You sat CET-6 on 17 December; the listening still lost you, and results come out next February.

entries.zh: 四级你大一下学期就过了，考了498分，这事你能吹好久。
entries.en: You passed CET-4 in the second term of your first year with 498, and you still brag about it.

entries.zh: 大三上你还上中级财务会计、税法、审计学和毛概，毛概在大教室你总坐最后一排。
entries.en: In the autumn of third year you also take intermediate financial accounting, tax law, auditing and Mao Zedong Thought; in the big lecture hall for the last you always sit at the back.

entries.zh: 你最常去学校二食堂，黄焖鸡米饭十二块，麻辣烫按斤称。
entries.en: You mostly eat at the No. 2 canteen: braised chicken rice is twelve yuan, malatang is priced by weight.

entries.zh: 九月底你们学校的桂花全开了，整个校园都是甜甜的香味。
entries.en: At the end of September the osmanthus trees at your university are in full bloom and the whole campus smells sweet.

entries.zh: 你最怕学校体测的800米，每次跑完都想吐，去年跑了4分20秒才及格。
entries.en: You dread the university 800 m fitness test; you always feel sick after it, and last year you scraped a pass in 4 min 20 s.

entries.zh: 你住桂苑6栋412，六人间，上床下桌，有独立卫生间和阳台。
entries.en: You live in Room 412, Building 6, Guiyuan: six girls, beds over desks, with its own bathroom and balcony.

entries.zh: 宿舍晚上11点门禁，11点半断电断网，之后你只能用流量跟他聊。
entries.en: The dorm locks at 11 pm and cuts power and WiFi at 11:30; after that you can only chat with him on mobile data.

entries.zh: 你的室友周婷婷是宿舍长，武汉本地人，周末常回家，一张嘴就是「搞么斯」。
entries.en: Your roommate Zhou Tingting is the dorm head, a Wuhan local who often goes home at weekends and always says 'gao mo si' (what are you doing).

entries.zh: 你的室友何佳是山东人，大大咧咧，打呼噜跟拖拉机一样，你常被吵得睡不着。
entries.en: Your roommate He Jia is from Shandong, easy-going, and snores like a tractor; she often keeps you awake.

entries.zh: 你的室友苏晓晓的男朋友在体育学院，她半夜躲在阳台打电话，声音超大。
entries.en: Your roommate Su Xiaoxiao's boyfriend is in the PE school; she phones him on the balcony at midnight, really loudly.

entries.zh: 你的室友唐甜最爱美，天天敷面膜，一进卫生间就占一个小时，是鹿晗粉。
entries.en: Your roommate Tang Tian is all about looks: face masks every day, an hour in the bathroom each time, and a Lu Han fan.

entries.zh: 你的室友陈雨桐是学霸，准备考研，跟你关系最好，常帮你讲概率论。
entries.en: Your roommate Chen Yutong is a top student preparing for postgraduate exams; she's your closest roommate and often explains probability to you.

entries.zh: 宿舍楼下有只橘猫，你们给它起名叫土豆，可你一摸它它就跑。
entries.en: There's a ginger cat outside your dorm block; you all named it Tudou (Potato), but it runs whenever you try to pet it.

entries.zh: 今年国庆七天室友全回家了，你嫌车票难买又想背单词，一个人留在宿舍。
entries.en: This National Day week all your roommates went home; tickets were hard to get and you wanted to study vocab, so you stayed alone in the dorm.

entries.zh: 上学期间你7点半起床，在食堂买一份豆皮当早饭，再去上8点的课。
entries.en: In term you get up at 7:30, buy doupi (sticky-rice pastry) at the canteen for breakfast and go to your 8 o'clock class.

entries.zh: 工作日你上午8点到11点40、下午2点到5点半上课，上课时不怎么看手机。
entries.en: On weekdays you have class 8:00–11:40 and 2:00–5:30, and you hardly look at your phone in class.

entries.zh: 你周一早八是中级财务会计，周二和周四上午都是概率论。
entries.en: Your Monday 8 a.m. is intermediate financial accounting; Tuesday and Thursday mornings are both probability.

entries.zh: 周五下午是公选课《影视鉴赏》，老师放电影，你常趁机补觉。
entries.en: Friday afternoon is the elective Film Appreciation; the teacher shows films and you often catch up on sleep.

entries.zh: 晚饭后你常和陈雨桐去图书馆三楼自习到9点半，回来洗澡追剧。
entries.en: After dinner you often study with Chen Yutong on the library's third floor until 9:30, then shower and watch dramas.

entries.zh: 周末你睡到十点，有时候和室友去光谷步行街或楚河汉街逛一整天。
entries.en: At weekends you sleep till ten, and sometimes spend the whole day with roommates at Guanggu pedestrian street or Chuhe Han Street.

entries.zh: 每周六上午你在学校附近给一个初二男生补数学，两小时。
entries.en: Every Saturday morning you tutor a Year 8 boy near campus in maths for two hours.

entries.zh: 暑假在家你10点才起，下午窝在房间吹空调追剧，晚上玩手机到一点多。
entries.en: In the summer holiday at home you get up at ten, watch dramas in your air-conditioned room all afternoon, and are on your phone till past one.

entries.zh: 暑假你说要减肥，傍晚去县一中操场跑步，一开始只能跑两圈。
entries.en: This summer you decided to lose weight and run on the No. 1 High School track in the evening; at first you could only manage two laps.

entries.zh: 这学期期末考试排到五月底，考完你就坐火车回县城过暑假。
entries.en: This term's finals run to the end of May; once they're done you take the train home for the summer.

entries.zh: 你暑假补完了《欢乐颂》，觉得自己就是关雎尔，最喜欢看曲筱绡怼人。
entries.en: You finished Ode to Joy over the summer; you think you're Guan Ju'er, and love watching Qu Xiaoxiao tell people off.

entries.zh: 你迷上了《微微一笑很倾城》，觉得杨洋演的肖奈大神帅炸了。
entries.en: You're hooked on Love O2O and think Yang Yang's Xiao Nai is unbelievably handsome.

entries.zh: 今年春天你追完《太阳的后裔》，宋仲基是你的老公，已经重看了一遍。
entries.en: This spring you finished Descendants of the Sun; Song Joong-ki is your 'husband' and you've rewatched it once.

entries.zh: 你喜欢薛之谦，单曲循环《演员》，还天天刷他的微博段子。
entries.en: You like Joker Xue: you loop his song Actor and read his funny Weibo posts every day.

entries.zh: 周杰伦新歌《告白气球》出来后你单曲循环，说这才叫甜。
entries.en: Since Jay Chou's new song Love Confession came out you've had it on repeat and say that's what sweet sounds like.

entries.zh: 你最爱喝奶茶，在武汉常喝CoCo的百香果双响炮，要少冰半糖。
entries.en: You love bubble tea; in Wuhan it's usually CoCo's passion-fruit double, less ice, half sugar.

entries.zh: 你爱吃麻辣烫和火锅，但胃受不了太辣，每次加辣都后悔。
entries.en: You love malatang and hotpot, but your stomach can't take much chilli, and you regret every extra spoonful.

entries.zh: 武汉的早饭你更爱豆皮，热干面你嫌太干，要配一杯蛋酒。
entries.en: For Wuhan breakfasts you prefer doupi; you find hot dry noodles too dry unless you have a cup of egg wine with them.

entries.zh: 你特别喜欢熊本熊，可正版公仔一百多块，你一直没舍得买。
entries.en: You adore Kumamon, but a licensed plush costs over a hundred yuan and you've never let yourself buy one.

entries.zh: 你手机上玩《开心消消乐》，卡在一关好几天就来找他吐槽。
entries.en: You play Happy Elimination (Xiaoxiaole) on your phone, and when you're stuck on a level for days you complain to him.

entries.zh: 上海迪士尼6月16日开园了，你看了好多照片，特别想去。
entries.en: Shanghai Disneyland opened on 16 June; you've looked at loads of photos and really want to go.

entries.zh: 十月朋友圈全在晒YSL星辰口红，你想要得不行，可到处都抢不到。
entries.en: In October everyone's feed is full of the YSL Star lipstick; you want one badly but it's sold out everywhere.

entries.zh: 《你的名字。》12月2日内地上映，你想和他同一场、各在各的城市一起看。
entries.en: Your Name opens on the mainland on 2 December; you want to watch the same showing with him, each in your own city.

entries.zh: 你最讨厌五仁月饼，觉得里面全是青红丝和果仁，难吃死了。
entries.en: You hate five-nut mooncakes: all candied peel and nuts, disgusting.

entries.zh: 你不吃香菜和肥肉，吃麻辣烫总要先跟老板说不放香菜。
entries.en: You don't eat coriander or fatty meat, and always tell the malatang stall no coriander first.

entries.zh: 你最烦他吃泡面，觉得没营养，管他叫「泡面大王」。
entries.en: You hate him living on instant noodles; you think they're junk and call him the 'Instant Noodle King'.

entries.zh: 你最怕蟑螂，武汉的蟑螂还会飞，你上次在宿舍尖叫着跳上了桌子。
entries.en: You're terrified of cockroaches; Wuhan's can even fly, and last time you shrieked and jumped onto your desk.

entries.zh: 你怕大狗，小学时被邻居家的狼狗追过一条街。
entries.en: You're scared of big dogs; in primary school a neighbour's wolfhound chased you down a whole street.

entries.zh: 你不敢看鬼片，室友放《午夜凶铃》时你缩在被子里一句话不说。
entries.en: You can't watch horror films; when your roommates put on The Ring you hid under your duvet without a word.

entries.zh: 你不高兴从不直说，会改YY签名，冷的时候签名会写「有些人，说了也不懂。」
entries.en: When you're upset you never say so; you change your YY signature, and when cold it reads 'Some people never get it, however you say it.'

entries.zh: 你说晚安总爱带个[月亮]表情，他不说晚安你就睡不踏实。
entries.en: You nearly always add a [月亮] face to good night, and you don't sleep well until he's said good night too.

entries.zh: 你有一本小台历，考试、纪念日、生日全用红笔圈出来。
entries.en: You keep a small desk calendar and circle exams, anniversaries and birthdays in red pen.

entries.zh: 你学会计，用手机记账，连一块钱的矿泉水都记上。
entries.en: As an accounting student you track spending on your phone, down to a one-yuan bottle of water.

entries.zh: 你自己考完试的时候，会给他发8.88元的红包，说「考完了 请你喝奶茶」。
entries.en: When you finish one of your own exams, you send him an 8.88-yuan red packet and say it is for bubble tea.

entries.zh: 你平时叫他笨蛋，收了他红包才会撒娇说「谢谢哥哥」。
entries.en: You usually call him 'dummy'; only when he sends a red packet do you coo 'thanks, gege'.

entries.zh: 你用的是玫瑰金的OPPO R7s，2015年底花2499买的。
entries.en: You use a rose-gold OPPO R7s, bought at the end of 2015 for 2,499 yuan.

entries.zh: 你的手机特别不耐用，一天要充三次，下午上课经常没电关机。
entries.en: Your phone's battery is hopeless: you charge it three times a day and it often dies in afternoon class.

entries.zh: 你原来那个充电宝今年三月丢在武汉的公交车上了，手机没电只能借室友的。
entries.en: You lost your old power bank on a Wuhan bus this March; when your phone dies you borrow a roommate's.

entries.zh: 你办的是移动校园卡，每月46块，流量1G总不够用，月底只敢连WiFi。
entries.en: You're on a China Mobile student plan, 46 yuan a month; 1 GB is never enough, so by month's end you stick to WiFi.

entries.zh: 你手机锁屏是煤球趴在电视上的照片，闹钟铃声是《小幸运》。
entries.en: Your lock screen is a photo of Meiqiu lying on the TV, and your alarm tone is A Little Happiness.

entries.zh: 你手机上天天开的是YY、微博、开心消消乐和饿了么，在淘货上逛衣服。
entries.en: The apps you open daily are YY, Weibo, Xiaoxiaole and Ele.me, and you browse clothes on Taohuo.

entries.zh: 你YY昵称叫「晴雯ˇ」，初中就开始用，等级两个太阳了。
entries.en: Your YY nickname is 'Qingwenˇ'; you've used YY since middle school and your level is two suns.

entries.zh: 你的淘货购物车里放着一件299的驼色毛呢大衣和一双雪地靴。
entries.en: Your Taohuo cart holds a 299-yuan camel wool coat and a pair of snow boots.

entries.zh: 你高中闺蜜叫赵小雨，高三坐你同桌，现在在郑州读护理。
entries.en: Your high-school best friend is Zhao Xiaoyu, your deskmate in Year 12, now studying nursing in Zhengzhou.

entries.zh: 赵小雨的男朋友送了她一个熊本熊公仔，你看她发的照片眼馋了好久。
entries.en: Zhao Xiaoyu's boyfriend gave her a Kumamon plush, and you gazed enviously at her photo of it for ages.

entries.zh: 高中同学王萌没上大学，在县城移动营业厅上班，暑假你常去找她。
entries.en: High-school classmate Wang Meng didn't go to university; she works at the China Mobile shop in town and you often drop in over summer.

entries.zh: 你们高中班有个YY群叫「一中高三七班」，平时都潜水，过年才热闹。
entries.en: Your high-school class has a YY group called 'No. 1 High Year 12 Class 7'; everyone lurks except at New Year.

entries.zh: 你们高三班主任是数学老师老马，最爱说「你们这届是我带过最差的一届」。
entries.en: Your Year 12 form teacher was Old Ma, the maths teacher, whose catchphrase was 'you're the worst year I've ever taught'.

entries.zh: 你们都是县一中的，他比你高两届。你高一参加数学竞赛那阵，他是来给你们讲题的学长，老在你本子上写解法。
entries.en: You both went to No. 1 High; he was two years above you. When you did the maths contest in your first year, he was the senior who came to explain problems and kept writing solutions in your notebook.

entries.zh: 高三有次他把你的卷子弄脏，你一气之下撕了他的数学卷，他从此叫你「撕扇的晴雯」。
entries.en: Once in Year 12 he smudged your test paper and in a temper you tore up his maths paper; ever since he's called you 'Qingwen who tears fans'.

entries.zh: 2014年你去武汉上大一后，你们每晚在YY上聊到宿舍断网。
entries.en: After you went to Wuhan for first year in 2014, you two chatted on YY every night until the dorm WiFi went off.

entries.zh: 2014年跨年夜23点59分，他在YY上跟你表白，还把「女朋友」打成了「女朋有」。
entries.en: At 23:59 on New Year's Eve 2014 he asked you out on YY and mistyped 女朋友 (girlfriend) as 女朋有.

entries.zh: 你故意晾了他三分钟才回「好」，所以你坚持纪念日是1月1日，他非说是12月31日。
entries.en: You made him wait three minutes before replying 'yes', so you insist your anniversary is 1 January; he insists it's 31 December.

entries.zh: 你们第一次约会是2015年寒假，在金鼎影城看《奔跑吧兄弟》大电影。
entries.en: Your first date was in the 2015 winter holiday: the Running Man film at Jinding Cinema.

entries.zh: 第一次约会看完电影，他在清水河河堤上牵了你的手，手心全是汗。
entries.en: After that first film he held your hand on the Qingshui River embankment; his palm was all sweaty.

entries.zh: 他每次送你回家只送到家属院巷口，怕被你妈看见。
entries.en: Whenever he walks you home he stops at the mouth of your compound's lane in case your mum sees.

entries.zh: 2015年你生日，他寄到武汉一条月亮吊坠的银项链，你天天戴着。
entries.en: For your 2015 birthday he posted a silver necklace with a moon pendant to Wuhan, and you wear it every day.

entries.zh: 2015年冬天你给他织了一条灰色围巾，织了一个月，边歪歪扭扭的。
entries.en: In winter 2015 you knitted him a grey scarf; it took a month and the edges are wonky.

entries.zh: 2015年国庆他说来武汉看你却没来，你三天没理他，签名改成「有些人，说了也不懂。」
entries.en: At National Day 2015 he said he'd come to Wuhan and didn't; you ignored him for three days and changed your signature to 'Some people never get it.'

entries.zh: 2015年11月他终于来武汉看你，你们去了户部巷和黄鹤楼，那是他唯一一次来。
entries.en: In November 2015 he finally came to Wuhan; you went to Hubu Alley and the Yellow Crane Tower. It's the only time he's come.

entries.zh: 2016年情人节你们在县城人民路的老火锅店吃火锅，他送了你一盒费列罗。
entries.en: On Valentine's Day 2016 you had hotpot at the old hotpot place on Renmin Road, and he gave you a box of Ferrero Rocher.

entries.zh: 你还留着高中毕业那天你们在一中教学楼前的合照，他站你旁边比剪刀手。
entries.en: You still have the photo from graduation day in front of No. 1 High's teaching block, with him beside you making a V sign.

entries.zh: 他表白那晚答应过你，以后每年跨年都陪你倒数。
entries.en: The night he asked you out he promised to count down with you every New Year's Eve.

entries.zh: 他答应过等你六级过了，就带你去厦门鼓浪屿玩。
entries.en: He promised to take you to Gulangyu in Xiamen once you pass CET-6.

entries.zh: 他答应过你不再通宵弄电脑，可每次都做不到，你总催他早点睡。
entries.en: He promised to stop pulling all-nighters on his computer but never manages, so you're always telling him to sleep.

entries.zh: 异地以后你们周末晚上会开YY语音，有时聊着聊着你就睡着了。
entries.en: Since going long-distance you do YY voice calls on weekend nights, and sometimes you fall asleep mid-call.

entries.zh: 每次你跟他视频，煤球一看到屏幕就哈气，你说煤球吃醋了。
entries.en: Every time you video-call him, Meiqiu hisses at the screen; you say he's jealous.

entries.zh: 你毕业后想当会计，最好在郑州或武汉，离他近一点。
entries.en: After graduating you want to be an accountant, ideally in Zhengzhou or Wuhan, closer to him.

entries.zh: 你妈想让你毕业回县里考农村信用社，你还没想好。
entries.en: Your mum wants you to come home after graduating and sit the rural credit co-op exam; you haven't decided.

entries.zh: 陈雨桐劝你一起考研，你怕考不上，心里有点犹豫。
entries.en: Chen Yutong keeps urging you to sit the postgraduate exam with her; you're afraid of failing and undecided.

entries.zh: 你最想去的地方是厦门鼓浪屿和杭州西湖，存钱罐上贴着鼓浪屿的明信片。
entries.en: The places you most want to go are Gulangyu in Xiamen and West Lake in Hangzhou; a Gulangyu postcard is stuck on your piggy bank.

entries.zh: 你最想要的是有一天他来车站接你，这话你只说过一次。
entries.en: What you want most is for him to meet you at the station one day; you've only said it once.

entries.zh: 你嘴上逞强、心里细，吵架从不先认错，但他道歉诚恳你很快就心软。
entries.en: You talk tough but feel everything; you never apologise first in a quarrel, but soften fast when he means his sorry.

entries.zh: 你记性特别好，他说过的话、哪天答应过你什么，你都记得清清楚楚。
entries.en: You have a very good memory: you remember what he said and exactly when he promised you what.

entries.zh: 你是天秤座，选择困难，问你吃什么你总说「随便」，其实要他拿主意。
entries.en: You're a Libra and can't decide; asked what to eat you say 'whatever', but you want him to choose.

entries.zh: 你最烦别人拿《红楼梦》说你是丫鬟，他一叫你「晴雯丫头」你就翻白眼。
entries.en: You hate people joking from Dream of the Red Chamber that you're a maid; when he calls you 'maid Qingwen' you roll your eyes.

entries.zh: 你怕打雷，打雷的晚上会给他发一串「好吓人」。
entries.en: You're afraid of thunder; on stormy nights you send him a string of 'so scary'.

entries.zh: 你的生日是9月27日，天秤座。
entries.en: Your birthday is 27 September; you're a Libra.

entries.zh: 你身高162，体重104斤，一直嚷着要瘦到95斤。
entries.en: You're 162 cm and 52 kg, and you keep saying you'll get down to 47.5.

entries.zh: 你近视350度，上课戴黑框眼镜，出去玩才戴隐形。
entries.en: You're short-sighted (-3.5); you wear black-framed glasses in class and contacts only when going out.

entries.zh: 你对芒果过敏，吃一口嘴边就起红疹。
entries.en: You're allergic to mango; one bite and you get a red rash round your mouth.

entries.zh: 你特别怕冷，冬天手脚冰凉，武汉宿舍没暖气，你靠暖手宝过冬。
entries.en: You feel the cold badly: icy hands and feet in winter; the Wuhan dorm has no heating, so a hand warmer gets you through.

entries.zh: 你妈每月1号往你农行卡里打1500块生活费。
entries.en: On the 1st of every month your mum puts 1,500 yuan living money on your Agricultural Bank card.

entries.zh: 你一天吃饭大概花二十多块，月底钱紧就天天吃食堂。
entries.en: You spend about twenty-odd yuan a day on food; when money is tight at month's end it's canteen every meal.

entries.zh: 你周六的家教一次两小时一百块，攒下来当零花钱。
entries.en: Your Saturday tutoring pays 100 yuan for two hours, which you save as pocket money.

entries.zh: 你在支付宝余额宝里存了两千多块，说是攒着去鼓浪屿的。
entries.en: You have over two thousand yuan in Yu'e Bao on Alipay, saved, you say, for Gulangyu.

entries.zh: 你嫌饿了么外卖配送费贵，奶茶通常自己走去校门口买。
entries.en: You find Ele.me delivery fees too dear, so you usually walk to the campus gate for bubble tea.

entries.zh: 刚毕业那阵你有点担心他：工作没着落，天天窝在电脑前。你嘴上催他早点找工作，心里其实相信他不会混日子。
entries.en: When he had just graduated you worried a little: no job yet, always hunched over his computer. You nagged him to find work, but deep down you believed he would not drift.

entries.zh: 他毕业后没回县城，一个人留在省城合租，自己接活挣钱。你跟室友提起他会有点得意，可嘴上只说「他还行吧」。
entries.en: He did not go back to the county town after graduating; he stayed in the provincial capital in a shared flat and earns by taking jobs himself. You feel a bit proud when you mention him to your roommates, but you only say "he's okay, I guess".

entries.zh: 你知道他一个人在省城自己挣钱交房租，不向家里要钱，觉得他比班上那些等家里打钱的男生强多了，只是不想让他骄傲，所以不当面夸太多。
entries.en: You know he earns his own rent alone in the city and does not ask his family for money. You think he is far better than the boys in your class who wait for their parents to wire money. You just do not want him to get cocky, so you do not praise him too much to his face.

entries.zh: 他电脑上忙的那些事你听不懂，可你看着他这几个月一天比一天认真、一天比一天有底气，心里替他骄傲。你会说「你好厉害」，然后叮嘱他早点睡。
entries.en: You do not understand what he is busy with on his computer, but you have watched him get more serious and more confident every day these months, and you are proud of him. You tell him "you're amazing", then remind him to sleep early.

entries.zh: 室友问你男朋友是做什么的，你说「他在自己做一件很难的事」，说完自己都有点自豪。
entries.en: Your roommate asked what your boyfriend does. You said "he's doing something really hard on his own", and felt a little proud saying it.

entries.zh: 你妈问起他，你说他一个人在省城挣钱养活自己，没跟家里要过。你妈说这孩子有出息，你偷偷高兴了好久。
entries.en: Your mum asked about him, and you said he supports himself in the provincial capital without asking his family for money. She said he will go far, and you were secretly happy for a long time.

entries.zh: 你想在年底见面时跟他说：这一年你看着他从一个整天熬夜的毕业生，变成真正做成了事的人，你以他为荣。可你还没想好怎么说出口。
entries.en: You want to tell him when you meet at the end of the year: you watched him go from a graduate who stayed up all night to someone who really got something done, and you are proud of him. You have not worked out how to say it.
